case: Current-checkout MongoDB census, browse and run_find consistency regressions
assertions: Collection-wide metadata discovers mixed BSON kinds and makes unsafe edits read-only.
A type change to a not-yet-read off-page document is included in same-cursor metadata and does not mutate the sibling.
A mutation to a document already read by the cursor returns the earlier value and confirms that scans do not provide snapshot isolation.
Browse uses one find for schema and page; it does not issue a second page find.
run_find merges a selected-page type change observed after its separate census and preserves canonical Extended JSON through materialized CSV and JSON exports.

native_contract_group.result: 12 passed, 0 failed; includes all five census/browse consistency tests and seven MongoDB BSON parser/edit contracts

remaining: The census is best-effort, not snapshot-isolated; writes can overwrite concurrent changes to already-read documents.
run_find does not detect type changes to off-page documents after its census.
Full-scan performance budgets at larger collection sizes, additional export combinations and installed editing remain unqualified.
